title: Hearty Golden Korean Rice Hwajeon
description: A comforting Korean dish featuring golden syrup and high-protein friendly ingredients, served in a kazan cauldron.
instructions: Rinse the glutinous rice thoroughly and soak it in water for 4 hours.
Drain the water and grind the rice into a fine powder using a blender or food processor.
In a large kazan cauldron, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the ground beef and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the soy sauce, golden syrup, salt, and black pepper to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Add the chopped green onions and toasted sesame seeds to the cauldron and stir to combine.
Gradually add the ground rice to the cauldron, stirring constantly to prevent lumps from forming.
Cook the mixture for 10 minutes, stirring frequently, until it is thick and syrupy.
Remove the cauldron from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes.
Serve the Hearty Golden Korean Rice Hwajeon hot, garnished with additional green onions and sesame seeds if desired.
